headline: Cultural Resources Committee

meeting.summary: Commissioners sent ferry recommendations, approved a plan for seven Lahaina homes with an archaeological monitor, and approved a letter on Section 106 changes.
meeting.recap: The commission voted to send its ferry recommendations to the Department of Transportation.[[1:12:40]] The commission heard an update on seven new single-family homes planned in a Lahaina historic district.[[1:14:24]] A new consultant said the team will start a new archaeological study in place of the earlier firm's work.[[1:19:12]] The commission approved the plan, adding that an archaeological monitor be present for all initial ground-disturbing work.[[1:49:16]] Commissioners discussed a federal proposal to rewrite Section 106 rules, which protect historic properties.[[1:51:57]] Staff said the change would leave consultation with Native Hawaiian organizations up to federal agencies.[[2:02:39]] The letter was approved with no opposition.[[3:12:23]] Staff said four rebuild projects in the historic district were approved by staff as close matches to pre-fire buildings.[[3:19:50]] The next meeting is October 1st, 2026.[[3:53:00]]
decided: The commission voted to send its recommendations on the ferry study to the Department of Transportation, with no opposition heard.
Item B was taken up before item A2, with no objection.
meeting.next: Planning staff said the commission's ferry comments would probably be sent sometime next week. The consultant said the team could at least send its proposal to the burial council for its consideration.
